plan.title: EXP-DRAFT-036 Clear absent on saved eRFX draft

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test tenant.
Set the condition under which Clear must not be offered.
Apply the additional configuration required by the case.
Provide the required draft title so the saved draft can be located and reopened.
Configure the eRFX draft with an RFQ stage rather than the default auction stage.
Apply an RFQ template so the draft is valid and its pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the required line item to make the draft complete enough to save.
Fill the RFQ pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Commit a schedule for the saved draft.
Create a draft with a vendor participant so the vendor controls are relevant.
Save the eRFX project as the draft under test.
Return to the events list to reopen the saved draft through the buyer flow.
Confirm the events list rendered before navigating to Drafts.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Verify that the saved draft appears in the Drafts list.
Reopen the saved eRFX draft for inspection.
Assert the expected behavior: Clear is not offered when lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation is Off.
